main_text.p: æstimationem juris-jurandi, & præcep-tum Christi de non jurando violare, & fratri offendiculum præbere, & semet perjurii periculo exponere.
main_text.head: SECT. IX.
main_text.p: Quartum & ultimum dignoscendi Ju-Cafus 38ramenti κριτήριον[?] est mens & Intentio ju-rantis. Esto enim non constet vel ex ver-bis ipsis, vel ex communi æstimatione hominum, aliquam sermonis formulam esse Juramentum: Siquis tamen ejusmodi formula usus, aut mentis suæ errore[?] aliquo putet se jurasse, aut ex aliqua dolosa intentione velit putari jurasse; ea formula etsi non sit revera & ex se juramentum, habebit tamen quoad ipsum hominem, ad omnem obligandi effectum in conscientia Juramenti instar, ita ut non modo mendacii, sed & per-jurii reus sit in foro interno, si fidem sibi datam violaverit. Ut enim judice Apo-stolo,Rom.14. qui æstimat aliquid esse κοινόν[?] quod ex se non est κοινόν, est illi tamen κοινόν[?], ita ut ab eo teneatur abstinere sicut à re verè commu-14.ni & impura: Sic a lege contrariorum qui aliquid æstimat esse ἅγιον[?], id est sa

page.notes: Right margin: cropped at the scan edge; only word fragments remain and cannot be read, so no right-hand notes are transcribed. Greek words marked [?] are partly cut or faint in the scan: κριτήριον, the first κοινόν, the second κοινόν, ἅγιον. "errore" is faint at the line end and marked [?]. Catchword "crum" completes "sacrum", which is split across the page end; the main text ends on "sa". Long s is rendered as s throughout (printed "fi" and "fe" forms read as "si" and "se"). Printed "Iuramentum" and "Iuramenti" are given with J, as in the book's own "Jurisjurandi".
